### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Report objective measurements (e.g., temperature) exactly as stated in the transcript; do not perform unit conversions unless explicitly provided.
[A-Section]: Limit assessments to explicit statements by the provider or direct interpretations of findings. Avoid generalized subjective statements (e.g., "symptoms are mild") unless explicitly stated by the provider.
[P-Section]: Include only explicit instructions and recommendations given by the provider for the *current illness*. Do not infer general health advice (e.g., diet, substance avoidance) or convert patient's current good habits into instructions. State follow-up plans precisely, differentiating between single, conditional follow-ups and "regular" schedules, and do not misrepresent follow-up timing or conditions for returning.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Report objective measurements (e.g., temperature) exactly as stated in the transcript; do not perform unit conversions unless explicitly provided.
[A-Section]: Limit assessments to explicit statements by the provider or direct interpretations of findings. Do not infer specific etiologies (e.g., viral, bacterial) or generalized subjective statements (e.g., "symptoms are mild") unless explicitly stated by the provider or confirmed by a test result mentioned in the transcript; stick to the stated diagnosis.
[P-Section]: Include only explicit instructions and recommendations given by the provider for the *current illness*. Do not infer general health advice (e.g., diet, substance avoidance) or convert patient's current good habits into instructions. State follow-up plans precisely, differentiating between single, conditional follow-ups and "regular" schedules, and do not misrepresent follow-up timing or conditions for returning.
